content.text:
Yes, I can see it. I downloaded the image from the issue and opened it. It's a cropped screenshot of a GitHub comment, 441×119 pixels, in dark mode:

- **Header:** an avatar, the username **pi-action-agent**, a **Bot** badge, and "4m ago – with pi-action-agent", where the second "pi-action-agent" is a blue link.
- **Comment heading:** a robot emoji 🤖 followed by **"pi Response"** in bold.
- **First line of the body:** "I opened three issues, each written against a made-up repo…" The bottom of the image cuts this line off, and a small inline-code snippet at the right edge starting with "ac…" is also cut off.

So it's a screenshot of an earlier reply from this pi agent. I can't tell from the visible text which three issues it means.

I didn't change any files, so there was nothing to commit.
